استتيبوا (form X)
# اُسْتُتِيبُوا (ustutībū) /us.tu.tiː.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَتَابَ (istatāba)
# اِسْتَتِيبُوا (istatībū) /is.ta.tiː.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَتَابَ (istatāba)
